newsitem.title: UK: NWE fuel oil barges rise gently as swaps firm.
newsitem.headline: NWE fuel oil barges rise gently as swaps firm.

text.p: NWE fuel oil barge prices lifted gently on Thursday as swaps firmed but little major business was concluded, traders said.

High sulphur barges were heard traded at $92 fob ARA before prices sank back to around $90 on an offer basis, with further falls expected following the conclusion of one trader's strategy of buying to push up pricing quotes.
A barge trade in Rotterdam was heard concluded at $88.50 fob.
Bunker interest was normal at around 20,000 tonnes but it was being aggressively pursued by one refiner, dealers said.
The high sulphur cargo market was stable after its recent rise with utilities happy to wait for the product to lose the boost inherited from this week's futures rally.
Low sulphur barges were up on the back of crude futures and short prompt supply. One refiner said he bought at $95 fob ARA on Tuesday and had been told figures were now higher.
"It will be difficult to find product now for less than $96 (fob ARA)," he said.
